review_evidence.text: If you come to visit Vienna... you Have to stay at <PERSON_0>’s AirBnb. We have stayed at over 150 AirBnb since 2013. This one stands at the top in regards to interior decor and Kind hospitality!! The location is the Best- in Leopoldstadt... so close to center of Vienna ( we walked there every day-) and so peaceful nights rest. We definitely will return!! Grocery stores all within 3-7 minutes away by foot... galore of bakeries and ramen joints along with local fare!!! Highly recommend

I've used airbnb pretty extensively for years now and I have scarcely encountered a more proactively helpful host. They, unprompted, told us about not only all the fun things to do, go see, and eat in their surrounding area but gave detailed, step-by-step instruction for exactly how to get to their place from any number of starting locations. I can't praise enough how responsive and helpful they were. That all being said, the place itself was great too with an absolutely unbeatable location especially for the price. We had zero problems going and seeing everything that was on our list and if you're nervous about learning the Vienna public transport system (don't be, it's super easy) the hosts will help you! I will say, the stairs to the loft portion where the bedroom is are a little steep and slippery, so if you're not a stairs-person that might be something to keep in mind. But otherwise do not hesitate, it was a wonderful stay.

<PERSON_0> is a thoughtful and caring host. He enhances the stay with an excellent guide full of recommendations and local tips to help guests find their way around the city and feel at home. <PERSON_0> & Sebastian's place is overall a very nice stay. Responsive hosts that helped us get what we needed. Area: quiet+safe. a couple restaurants + McD not too far away. approx 15 min train ride to get to main tourist areas. pretty easily accessible from Vienna Central Station. Place itself: appreciated the washer. bedroom was a tad small, and the bed was a double size, not American queen so a tad tight for 2 people. washroom was a bit outdated. I did not smell any sewer smell like some of the other reviews, but the toilet design was weird so if you use it, the smell would waft into the entire bathroom. thankfully they provide airfreshener living room was nicely decorated and spacious. we did notice that it had a stale cigarette smell but it didn't bother us. good stay for the price!

Good stay for the price and location. I loved the self check in process. The hosts were very nice. We had to print our train tickets and the host was able to do that for us without any issues. We ran out of toilet paper in the last few days and the hosts were able to provide more without any issues. We were also able to leave our luggages and bags at the apartment after we checked out so that was excellent! Please note that the bedroom and the bathroom are very small and cramped. My husband and I bumped ourselves on the bed, the shower, and the sinks frequently throughout the stay. The bedroom and bathroom felt more like a one-person apartment than two. I do wish there were more laundry pods (and toilet paper). As with most European apartments, there is no AC and to get into the unit, there are two flights of stairs with no elevators. Pack what you can carry!

What a great place to stay. It was so convenient to get to so many sights & attractions, which was the main reason for our stay and it was literally just minutes walk to shops and other facilities. The accommodation was enough for my sister & me, as the downstairs TV room easily converted into an additional bedroom, besides which, who wants to watch TV when you have such a beautiful city to enjoy?! The facilities at the apartment were all we needed and I am sure that had anything gone wrong (which It didn't) then the hosts Motti & Annemarie would have sorted, as they great at keeping in contact while we were there.

It was the perfect location and was walkable to everything we wanted to do! When we did take public transportation it was extremely easy to find and walk to. The hosts were some of the best we’ve stayed with because of their quick response time, friendliness, recommendations, and flexibility. Their rules were easy to follow and I would recommend this place to anyone who is looking to visit Vienna!

This was not our favourite Airbnb experience. The apartment had potential because it’s big and nice and in a good location. However it had nothing on the walls which made it feel stark and cold. I do not generally complain but I feel I have to give an honest review. The biggest problem was that it lacked supplies that should have been provided. We arrived on a Sunday when stores are closed in Austria. We were told by the person who showed us in that all the coffee and laundry detergent had been used up by the previous person and because it was Sunday, he couldn’t get us any. The place is nice and location good. So why am I giving a harsh rank? Because received two different sets of instructions how to get in. One set was on Airbnb "How do I get in" section and it said to use a certain 4-digit number to open key box (the wrong number). The other set of instructions was emailed to me when I was already travelling w/o reliable access to internet and it gave the correct number. So I arrive 1am, tired, with crying kids and I am unable to get inside because the number I was given does not open the stupid key box. This was an infuriating situation. I almost smashed the box and prob got arrested. <PERSON_1> though all my messages again before doing so and found the alternative 4-digit number. Everything is less important in an accommodation than accessibility. The responsibility to communicate clearly rests 100% on the host in this situation and the traveller is an vulnerable position. So here is why I am ranking this otherwise fine place so low.
